title: Capability
description: One named operation as it appears in a *single* source system (e.g. matlab-v1's `eig`). Cross-system equivalence lives in aliases/, not here. v2 amendment 2026-05-23 (bead scientist-workbench-corpus-q4r, sibling to 3pu): adds optional signature.domain / signature.codomain, mapping[].flags / mapping[].precision_tier, and verification.method = 'arbprec_oracle' to express complex-valued domains, head-dispatched tools, precision tiers, and arb-prec multi-oracle anchors. All additions are backwards-compatible.

system.description: Source system identifier. Free-form to allow new systems without schema bumps; conventional values include mathematica, matlab, macsyma, maple, reduce, sympy, maxima, octave, scientist-workbench.

signature.$comment: domain/codomain added in v2 (bead q4r) to give tools/special-eval and tools/linalg-*-complex a structured real-vs-complex marker; the input/output strings remain source-faithful free-form text.

input.description: Free-form, source-faithful description of input shape.

domain.description: Structured marker for the scalar domain of the input(s): 'real' for real-valued args, 'complex' for complex-valued args, 'both' when the operation is defined over both, 'unspecified' when not yet classified.

codomain.description: Structured marker for the scalar codomain of the output: 'real', 'complex', 'mixed' when a tuple/struct output mixes real and complex components, or 'unspecified' when not yet classified.

benchmark.description: Pointer to the tournament-protocol benchmark suite that grades this capability. Optional — capabilities can exist without a graded suite (V0/V1).

suite.description: Path to benchmarks/<name>/manifest.toml, relative to corpus root.

conflict.description: true ⇒ at least one other provenance row disagrees on this field's value; both are kept (QuantumHardware.jl pattern).

verification.description: Verification lattice (Integralis-derived). Levels are monotonic; method records what produced the upgrade.

method.description: What produced the current verification level. 'arbprec_oracle' (added v2, bead q4r) marks an arbitrary-precision multi-oracle anchor — e.g. bench/erf-anchor and bench/besselj-anchor cross-check 5 independent oracles at high precision; sits between oracle_run and cross_system_consensus in stringency.

mapping.description: Bridge to a downstream implementation. One TOML can carry many mappings (one per target).

items.$comment: flags + precision_tier added in v2 (bead q4r). flags supports head-dispatched tools like special-eval (--head=BesselJ) per the workbench's special-functions epic; precision_tier records whether the mapping exercises the float64 path, the arb-prec path, or both.

flags.description: Structured key/value flags passed to the downstream tool's CLI. Lifts what used to be free-form prose in `notes` into a queryable shape; e.g. {"head": "BesselJ"} for tools/special-eval, or {"precision": "53"} to pin a precision tier.

precision_tier.description: Which numerical-precision tier this mapping exercises: 'float64' (numerical=true path), 'arbprec' (arbitrary-precision oracle path), or 'both' when the same mapping covers both tiers.
